subject: Human Body
title: Pregnancy Hormones
description: A quick win: understand Pregnancy Hormones.

hook.text: Within days of implantation, a new hormone appears: hCG. It's what pregnancy tests detect. A chemical announcement.

buildup.text: hCG keeps the corpus luteum alive, maintaining progesterone levels. Without it, the lining sheds and the embryo is lost.

discovery.text: By the second trimester, the placenta takes over hormone production.

climax.text: Pregnancy reshapes the entire hormonal landscape.

punchline.text: Pregnancy rewires hormones so completely the body is barely the same.

quiz.question: What hormone do pregnancy tests detect?
